description: Convert deprecated muckshroom spores to muckshroom spores
Convert deprecated purple mushrooms to muckshrooms
You can let Jackie know we're making good progress! Maybe don't mention the pick thing, hah!

name: A Good Sign
description: These frames are something I like to make when things are slow out here! They’re not much but they really help make your campsite feel like your own!

name: ADMIN — Green Thumb
description: If we work together we can breathe life back into this place. Go ahead and fill one of these planters with that grass you've got...

name: ADMIN — Tree is Company
description: These gardens are as much yours as they are mine! Pick whichever seed you'd like and plant it.

name: All in a Day's Work
description: I thinky-dink a sturdy Workbench at camp will be much needed when you’re on your adventures! Go pick some blue blossoms, press some paper, and it'll be up and running in no time!!

name: An Old Soul
description: The mountains around here are quite treacherous this time of year. Ol' Coop makes sure nothing that’s brewing up there gets too close to the city. I think they could use your help!

name: Basecamp
description: Your Campsite is your home away from home. It’s simple-dimple to set up and you can pack it and move-diddly-oove it whenever you’d like. Oh yeah! And whatever you build on top of it is protected from others. Let me show you...

name: Cast of Characters
description:
A real cast of characters around here, huh?
{break} I'm talking to some friends about getting you your own plot of land but it might take a bit.
{break} It might be helpful to meet with some folks who have left The Grove to learn about life beyond these walls.

name: Coffee Delivery DEP
description: Murray sent ya, eh? Great! Here's the thing...{break}After the Muckkening we've lost a handful of key seeds.{break}We've discovered we can get them back by **crossbreeding**.{break}We've discovered that when different species are grown next to each other, sometimes a completely new seed pops out!{break}We recently grew coffee but are still trying to find the exact pattern.{break}Can you study the plants behind me and see if you can't recreate it yourself?

name: Decoding This Muck
description: Bring this to Jo in the den immediately. They've been studying the Mucker language since they first arrived...

name: Empty Power Cell
description: Refill to increase Robot power supply by 15%

name: From The Top
description: Let’s get you out of those rags and into something nicer...

name: Get Blasted
description: Ay! Welcome back! It looks like you've been busy! Ready to continue your Engineering training? Let me help ya scrap together a Thermoblaster on your new land! here, take this recipe...

name: Get the Muck Outta Here
description: There's an overgrowth of Mossy Mucklings! To keep Mosslawn’s ecology thriving we need to turn a few of these muckers back into spores! They're feisty, but if you get chomped I've got a cozy campfire outside for you to rest at.

name: Getting Your Hands Dirty
description:
Good to see ya again, {username}!
{break} Ready to get yer hands dirty?

name: Getting Your Hands Dirty
description: Ah shoot! To make the matching skirt you’ll need a little something extra to bind the grass together. I know just the spot...

name: Gia's Lost Wallet
description: My wallet! Oh no! It must either be in our room? Or did I lose it on the boat? Or during our swim? It must be around here somewhere!

name: Gift
description: Someone has left you a gift!

name: Gifting Reward
description: A gift for the gifter!

name: Gimme Shelter
description: Dear {username}, it’s Taye here writing you from Watt! {break} If you’re reading this then you must be staring at a freshly claimed plot of land. Congratulations! {break} Your land is a blank canvas. What you build here will define how you contribute back to the world. A farm, a restaurant, a shop, a place to play games, or all of the above! {break} However, to accomplish any of those goals, you’re going to need a sturdy floor, strong walls, and a solid roof over your head.  {break} Enclosed in this package you’ll find three blueprints, choose one to get you started.

name: Golden Turnip (Planted)
description: A golden turnip with soil still around it.

name: Got A Light?
description: Alright, alright, I’ve heard about you! Well, by now you know the moon ain’t enough to keep your land lit. You’ll need a little something extra for those long nights at the Thermoblaster!

name: Grassy Gear
description:
Hah! I see your outfit hasn't changed...
{break} I could give you something I've made, but what would that teach you?
{break} Here, take the Grassy Top recipe. Craft it, wear it, and then come back to me!

name: Grove A-Go-Go
description: You're back, {username}! I've been testing a new game if you're interested in trying it out?

name: Haulin' Grass
description:
Grass ain't quite sturdy enough for roads but if you pack it tightly it can be a really useful!
{break} Try placing your grass blocks under the road extension over there to support it.

name: Hit the Road
description:
Right then! Nice to meet ya {username}!
{break} I'm Billy, head of construction for the new roads in and out of The Grove.
{break} These roads are useful for finding your way around this place, also the Muckers seem to stay off 'em.
{break} Say, would you mind clearing up some of the Grass blocks on road over there?

name: Home on the Range
description: It’s pretty safe around the city but to survive far beyond these walls you’ll need a bit more training. I know just the person you should meet...

name: I Can't Contain Myself
description: You've got a Workbench don't ya? That recipe I just gave ya should really help lighten your load...

name: I've Been Framed
description:
You've got quite the artistic eye!
{break} The Grove walls are covered in picture frames. Choose a frame of your liking and replace it's contents with that photo you just took.

name: In Rod We Trust DEP
description: Holy mackerel! This is worse than I thought! {break} I'd venture a guess that we've got ourselves some Muck Suckers in our very own Rolland Pond! {break} It won't be easy but if you're up for the challenge you'll need to talk with Rod about what it takes to bag a beast like that.

name: Introductions
description: Speaking of friends, you should introduce yourself to a few more of the folks who are helping out around here.

name: Juggement Day
description: Taller than an oak tree, wider than a campsite, teeth like neptunium... you’ve probably heard those whispers around Stoke. I’ve encountered a few Jugger Muckers in my travels so if you’re crazy enough to go looking I’d advise not to do it alone!

name: Lay of the Land
description: Has Jackie sent you off to learn how to craft a Land Flag? No? Let's bring 'em a little proof that you're up for any challenge...

name: Minced
description:
I was a chef in Watt before the Muckers showed up and I've never seen anything quite like this!
{break} Take a few slabs of Raw Mucker Meat to a workbench, a quick dice, chop, pop, and voila!

name: Mine Your Business
description: I want to make a name for myself as a miner...

name: Moe Problems
description: While you were out we got word that Mosslawn has been overrun with Muckers. I think Moe could use your help...

name: Moe Than Meats The Eye
description:
You made your way over from The Grove? Well you must have heard quite a bit about the Muckers by now!
{break} I won't bore you with another story about the Muckopalypse. Our research is strictly forward looking.
{break} One positive thing we've learned about these Muckers is whatever mutation they've gone through turns parts of them edible.
{break} The results of eating their meat have been mixed but Izzy and I are discovering ways to prepare them as a proper food source.
{break} Bring us back as much as you can and we'll keep experimenting.

name: Morning Sun
description: The photos behind me? They're from Mairu's latest creation, the Temple of the Sun. Mairu was one of the greatest architects to ever pass through The Grove. His buildings are a labyrinth of passages, traps, and secrets. Follow the clues embedded into it's halls and you might find yourself standing in front of the master themself at the top.

name: Mucky Waters DEP
description: **A Letter from Gil Hooker at Rolland Pond** {break}To whom it may concern... {break} There have recently been some rather mucky happenings in the waters at Rolland Pond and we could use any help we can get. {break} Grab a **Training Rod** and head over as soon as you can.

name: Nick Test 2
description: DO NOT USE: Test Quest

name: Nuthin' to Muck With
description: Jackie sent ya? Great! We need some warm bodies out here turning these Muckers into pebbles! Hold on to their teeth, us Engineering types can use them to make some pretty special things...

name: On the Chopping Block
description: Head back out of the main entrance and grab yourself a few log-aroos!

name: On the Mend
description: Oh what joy to see your face! I could use a hand...{break}I need to upkeep my fence but my ol' rusty tools aren't cutting it.{break}Would you be a doll and fetch me a **Silver Fencer**? I'd repay you handsomely.

name: Pack Up Camp
description: I’d say you’re a certified Rangeroo yourself now! If you wouldn’t mind packing up your Campsite before you head back would be much appreciated!

name: Parcel
description: Someone has left you a parcel!

name: Point and Shoot
description:
Ah ha! I could tell you had a knack for photography when we first met!
{break} Every photographer must keep their B-01 Camera on them at all times. Point. Shoot. Repeat.
{break} Find something inspiring to you and take a photo of it and then come back to me.

name: Potato
description: Maybe I could eat these if I roasted them...

name: Protecto Pack I
description: Increase a robot's protection by 15%

name: Pull Up a Chair
description: Campsite? Check. Fire? Check. A few chairs to rest on? Let’s giddily-go!

name: Robot Test Quest
description: Robot Test Quest

name: Rocky Climb
description:
Before you head back, I could actually use another pair of eyes.
{break} Max and I have been bringing gravel to and from these piles all week and at some point I lost my tools!
{break} Can you take a look around and see if you can find my Pick?

name: Roll Model
description: So, like, repairing my dock is a little out of my budget right now. But whoa, would you ever help me with some marketing photos? I can already feel my sales hitting an all time high!

name: Run Amuck
description: Quick! Enter the passageway beside me and race to the end to see what you can find!

name: Sheep Happens
description: Golly me, I’ve been piddlin’ around and forgot to feed my sheep.{break}**Muck Suckers** seem to make these animals happier than a pig in mud. I’ll trade you our family recipe if you can help.

name: Shores' Shop Shop
description: So yer lookin' to start, like, your own business? Far out! I've got a shop of shops for you to shop at! Well, I think I did? It might be chillin' on the bottom of the river after that swell...

name: Something is Amuck
description: While you're here, these very peculiar statues have been popping up around Mosslawn. Would you mind documenting them with your camera and running the photos back to Jackie for some analysis?

name: Something is Fishy DEP
description: The name's Gil, pleasure to meet ya. I've been fishin' in Rolland Pond since before the Muckening and lately somethin' just ain't been right. {break} We’ve noticed some of the fish we’re catchin’ aren’t lookin’ too hot. To be honest, we’re a bit worried that some muck is festering below sea level. {break} We need someone to **catch a few fish** from this here pond so we can measure the toxin levels. You up for it?

name: Squad Goals
description:
I think after what happened we need eachother more than ever.
{break} Let's start making some new memories, together.

name: Staking Claim
description: This is major! Congratulations. If there was a city that you were drawn to, head back to that area and claim your own piece of this world. Your journey has just begun...

name: Suspicious Statues 1
description:
Mosslawn is littered with these suspicious Mucker Statues. The Muckers seem to be drawn to them.
{break} Go investigate the statues and report any findings back to me.

name: Suspicious Statues 2
description: It looks like there might be more to this... I'll keep investigating.

name: Suspicious Statues 3
description: It looks like there might be more to this... I'll keep investigating.

name: Suspicious Statues 4
description: It looks like there might be more to this... I'll keep investigating.

name: Tailor Made
description: Waouh! We've been awaiting your arrival! To continue your training down the path of the Artist you'll most certainly need your own Tailoring Booth. Here, follow these instructions...

name: Takeout or Delivery
description:
Psst... over here!
{break} You must be {name}, Moe's new recruit.
{break} I've been out in the field trying to figure out exactly what Muckers are attracted to and repelled from.
{break} I think I'm close and I think these Red Mushrooms are involved.
{break} Don't touch any of the ones in Mosslawn, but see if you can go out and find me some more.

name: Tansons Test
description: LETS TEST

name: The Fabric
description: Land Flag Fabric? Not yet. An Artist must first learn to find inspiration in what we call ‘les fruits de mère nature’. Immerse yourself in the gardens around Arbre and then talk with Zoé.

name: The Fabric II
description: If your desire is the Flag Fabric then you must become skilled with a Tailoring Booth. You'll need to get some practice in, and maybe a new outfit, before you can make Flag Fabric.

name: The Fabric III
description: Find a photographer, find your light, and pose! Dimmí will be excited to see your progress...

name: The Fabric IV
description: You know what to do! Return to me when you've crafted your Flag Fabric!

name: The Grass is Always Greener
description: See everything around us? My friends and I built it all with our bare hands. With a little of our help you'll be able to own a piece of this world yourself. Ready to get started?

name: The Hilt
description: Hmm... a Land Flag Hilt? Don’t concern yourself with that for now. Show us Survivalists that you can build shelter on your Campsite before we talk about owning land.

name: The Hilt II
description: We just got word from the Duff Outpost that the forest they're protecting has become infested with some nasty Muckers. If you can help out I'm sure Alexis will finally teach you how to make that hilt...

name: The Hilt III
description: Before you head back, take that Boombox I gave you and place it in your Campsite. It’ll keep you company while you’re finishing up your Flag Hilt.

name: The Hilt IV
description: When claiming your land make sure to grip your flag tightly!

name: The Pole
description: Ay! A Flag Pole? Engineers have been making these for years! Sil and Luis up in the mines can get you started. It's a bit dangerous trek there so let me know when you've made it! And bring some rocks with ya...

name: The Pole II
description: Ya ever fired up a Thermoblaster before?! Toss in some Cobblestone and let 'er rip! These mines are a bit of a maze so make sure you have a few extra flares in tow. They're bright but they burn out pretty quickly...

name: The Pole III
description: An Engineer keeps two things on them at all times: a Pick and a pic! The Pick for mining and the pic for a swift exit! You knew you could warp with photos ya?

name: The Pole IV
description: Nothing standing between you and the pole but a coupla’ rocks!

name: The Road Back
description: Head back to Jackie and let her know we're making good progress! Maybe keep the Pick thing between us, hah!

name: This Sucks DEP
description: As far as we know there are **six legendary Muckerfish** spread out across the land and each one is more elusive than the last. {break} However, I've heard stories about the Muck Sucker and from what I gather, they like to wait until sundown to come out. Think you can catch it?

name: To The Bottom
description: You're getting the hang of this! A little clay, a little grass, a nice long skirt to cover your...

name: Top Secret
description:
Emma doesn't believe me, but I was snooping around upstairs and found an old duct.
{break} I think it leads to whatever was built here before the Muckers destroyed everything.

name: Turnip (Planted)
description: A turnip with soil still around it.

name: Undertoe
description: Who am I? Part of the crew that built this place. I was in charge of the underground, most of which has been sealed up for years... most. You didn’t hear it from me, but I hear grumblings about some folks trading in an old room right under Jackie's toes. Be discrete, Jackie would not approve.

name: Undocked Dock
description: Looks like you need some threads for your head. Unfortunately, that gnarly swell took out a chunk of my dock and I lost most of my stock! It's floating around here somewhere...

name: What Does It Mean?
description: I better bring these inscriptions back to Moe

name: What's up, Doc?
description: There was a big swell in the river just southeast of here. {break}Would you go check on my old friend Doc? They’re one of the biggest importers to The Grove.

name: When In Chrome DEP
description: I once heard a story about a novice angler like yourself gettin' yanked out to sea because they hooked a Muck Sucker with the wrong rod. {break} To catch a fish the size of a Muck Sucker you're going to need to buy one of my **Chrome Rod**'s and they aren't cheap.
